item.title: Noun-verb-conjunction triads [D]
item.description: The neural network would consist of multiple layers with at least one layer consisting of multiple attention heads. Each attention head would hold one triad consisting of one noun + one verb + one conjunction. The siamese cat ate the mouse then died: (Null) Cat ate also Mouse eaten and cat is-siamese Then cat died "Also" means the two events are the same event. (Not in english). A possible conclusion would be "because mouse poisoned" which could then be appended to the input and the process repeated. In addition a few other ideas can be added to each attention head: * the, a, same, this, that, — 来源：arxiv · reddit_ml — 原文：https://www.reddit.com/r/MachineLearning/comments/1xbtzv9/nounverbconjunction_triads_d/

item.title: The Dynamics of Collapse and Recovery in Clustered Federated Learning
item.description: Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse. item.title: LocaLeJEPA: Maximum Entropy Representations under Geometric Priors
item.description: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer an appealing approach to self-supervised learning, but are typically prone to representation collapse. LeJEPA resolves this by introducing a theoretically grounded distribution-matching objective that drives the embedding towards an isotropic Gaussian. However, this approach is fundamentally tied to Euclidean assumptions, and its global target does not reflect domain-specific geometric priors, such as the use of non-Euclidean embedding geometries, e.g., equivariant CNNs or hyperbolic ViTs. item.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
item.description: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience.
